name: io.github.smdesai27/math-board
title: Math board
description: A local, view-only chalkboard the model draws on: equations, plots, molecules and diagrams.

environmentVariables.name: MATH_BOARD_NO_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 and board_open only returns the board's URL instead of opening it in the default browser.

environmentVariables.name: MATH_BOARD_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for this board's autosave and named saves, used as given (PI_MATH_BOARD_DATA_DIR, the old name, also works). Default: the mcp/ subfolder of the board's data folder. A plain checkout keeps lessons in <package>/.data; an npm or npx install uses a per-user folder: ~/Library/Application Support/math-board on macOS, $XDG_STATE_HOME/math-board or ~/.local/state/math-board on Linux, %LOCALAPPDATA%\math-board on Windows.
